Coupled Technique(s).cell: ID-TIMS U-Pb on an Isotopx X-62 at MIT, and solution Q-ICP-MS (Agilent 7700) for Zr and Hf concentrations, on aliquots of the same dissolutions
Coupled Technique(s).value: ID-TIMS U-Pb on an Isotopx X-62 at MIT, and solution Q-ICP-MS (Agilent 7700) for Zr and Hf concentrations, on aliquots of the same dissolutions

Coupling Description.cell: Functional: 3 M HCl washes from the U-Pb anion chemistry were collected and became the Zr aliquots, so the same crystal yields a U-Pb date and a Zr isotopic composition. Sequence: U-Pb purification first, Zr purification from its washes
Coupling Description.value: Functional: 3 M HCl washes from the U-Pb anion chemistry were collected and became the Zr aliquots, so the same crystal yields a U-Pb date and a Zr isotopic composition. Sequence: U-Pb purification first, Zr purification from its washes

Target Material.cell: zircon; baddeleyite; bulk rock — single crystals and bulk rock of the FC-1 anorthositic gabbro (Duluth Complex)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Single crystal — "Single zircon and baddeleyite crystals selected for analysis were individually handpicked"; each "individually loaded into clean PFA microcapsules"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Crushing in a stainless steel mortar, sieving through 375 µm plastic mesh, washing in a plastic gold pan, hand magnet, Frantz LB-1 magnetic separation, methylene iodide heavy liquid, hand picking under high-purity ethanol
Sample Preparation Method.value: Crushing in a stainless steel mortar, sieving through 375 µm plastic mesh, washing in a plastic gold pan, hand magnet, Frantz LB-1 magnetic separation, methylene iodide heavy liquid, hand picking under high-purity ethanol

Digestion Acid(s).cell: chemical abrasion: 29 M HF; U-Pb dissolution: 29 M HF; Zr-only dissolution: 20% HNO3, then 29 M HF; spike equilibration: N

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: "clean Teflon microcapsules" inside "a large-volume Parr digestion vessel"
Digestion Vessel Type.value: "clean Teflon microcapsules" inside "a large-volume Parr digestion vessel"

Digestion Step.cell: chemical abrasion (19 zircons for U-Pb, annealed at 900 °C for 60 h, then leached in 29 M HF in a Parr vessel at 215 °C for 12 h); U-Pb dissolution (dated crystals, 29 M HF in microcapsules in a Parr vessel, 215 °C, 48 h); Zr-only dissolution (crystals not dated, fluxed in 20% HNO3 at 60 °C for 2 h, then 29 M HF in microcapsules in a Parr vessel, 215 °C, 60 h); spike equilibration (with the ⁹¹Zr–⁹⁶Zr spike, fluxed at 140 °C overnight, dried down twice and redigested) — Materials and Methods

Digestion Temperature.cell: chemical abrasion: 900 °C (annealing), then 215 °C; U-Pb dissolution: 215 °C; Zr-only dissolution: 60 °C, then 215 °C; spike equilibration: 140 °C

Digestion Duration.cell: chemical abrasion: 60 h, then 12 h; U-Pb dissolution: 48 h; Zr-only dissolution: 2 h, then 60 h; spike equilibration: overnight

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: 0.59 M HNO3 + 0.28 M HF at 60 ng/g total Zr — samples and bracketing standards matched in concentration and acid matrix

value.value: 0.59 M HNO3 + 0.28 M HF at 60 ng/g total Zr

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: Single crystals; ~50 µl (5% of sample) taken for concentration measurement
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: Single crystals; ~50 µl (5% of sample) taken for concentration measurement

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes, AG-1X for U-Pb; Ln-Spec (~300 µl, 25–50 µm) for Zr, giving >95% Zr, undetectable REEs and <3% of initial Hf; TODGA first stage for bulk rocks
Chromatographic Separation Applied.value: Yes, AG-1X for U-Pb; Ln-Spec (~300 µl, 25–50 µm) for Zr, giving >95% Zr, undetectable REEs and <3% of initial Hf; TODGA first stage for bulk rocks

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: In-house 91Zr-96Zr double spike, added at a 0.43:0.57 spike-to-sample Zr mass ratio
Isotope Dilution Spike.value: In-house 91Zr-96Zr double spike, added at a 0.43:0.57 spike-to-sample Zr mass ratio

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: Nu Instruments — "a Nu Plasma II MC-ICP-MS fitted with an enhanced sensitivity interface"

Nebulizer Type.cell: N — introduction through a Cetac Aridus II desolvator nebulizer

Reported Variables and Units.cell: δ91/90Zr, δ92/90Zr, δ94/90Zr, δ96/90Zr — ‰ relative to ZrNIST; δ⁹⁴/⁹⁰Zr is the one discussed

Baseline Measurement Approach.value: "On-peak-zero correction was done using the mean acid blank intensities before data processing to account for blank contribution as well as any 'memory' effects from the Aridus II sample introduction system during the run"

Blank / Background Correction Method.value: On-peak-zero correction using mean acid blank intensities
